findings.detail: Two distinct AWS October30 product events remained generic pending despite relevant primary leads: Bedrock runtime API/cross-region support and Kiro GovCloud web search. Resolution evidence: Both are now date-only watch cards, independently read Kiro original and author full Bedrock source extraction; runtime versus Mantle desktop paths distinguished.

DRCF explanatory prose exceeded fetched primary landing-page evidence when it described specific autonomous-deployer liability. Resolution evidence: Final prose limits itself to existing-framework applicability and inter-regulator coordination. Full statement PDF was not read; no new statute or detailed liability rule asserted.

Generic pending aliases obscured original-event assessments and inflated unresolved identity counts. Resolution evidence: All198 reconciliation overrides inspected, all960records retained, no duplicate cycles/missingtargets, selected canonical events unchanged. Exact event identity, not publisher identity, controls alias mapping.

Earlier draft attributed an October28 agreement date to the cited NBD01AI source without support. Resolution evidence: Date clause removed; public summary confines itself to the October30 report, unspecified amount/valuation/round and intended headquarters arrangement.

Late Granite alias correction introduced a two-record duplicate cycle. Resolution evidence: Final cycle audit identified a31-c-2b0c3310d3 and facts31-c-lead-6621793ecf; author corrected the canonical older-event disposition and retained the alias provenance.
